== Notes ==
* The attack damage is not reduced.
* Retribution deals [[holy damage]].
* Damage is rounded up to a minimum of 1.
* Retribution will only trigger on the damage from attacks, not on the indirect damage from [[Hundred Blades]] or [[Vow of Strength]].
* Returned damage is calculated ''after'' the effects of enchantments (e.g. [[Protective Spirit]]), therefore is useless for [[55 Monk]]s.
* Retribution is one of the keystone skills of [[600]]+[[smiter]] combinations.
{{bug|If you somehow manage to maintain Retribution on a [[foe]], it will not deal damage back to you or your allies.}}
